adult.text: CMV retinitis induction (normal renal function): 90 mg/kg IV (1-1/2 to 2 hour infusion) every 12 hours or 60 mg/kg (≥1 h) every 8 hours for 2-3 weeks; maintenance 90-120 mg/kg/day over 2 hours. Acyclovir-resistant HSV: 40 mg/kg every 8 or 12 hours for 2-3 weeks or until healed. Max infusion rate 1 mg/kg/min.
